How it works

  • State (14 numbers): danger straight/right/left, heading, food direction, and how much free space is reachable in each of the three moves.
  • Actions: go straight, turn right, turn left.
  • Reward: +10 for food, −10 for dying or starving, ±0.1 for moving closer/farther from the food (shaping).
  • Learning: Double DQN with experience replay, a target network, Huber loss and Adam; 128-128 MLP.
